assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
The service described is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The denial cited that precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness.
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
